Actual Result: Server returns 400 Bad Request with plaintext issue message

Title: Geofence Bypass: Attendance Punch Accepts Mock GPS / Spoofed Coordinates
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Enable mock location app in Developer Options 2. Set coordinates to office 3. Open Kredily 4. Tap Clock In
Expected Result: App detects Location.isMock() and rejects punch with security warning
Actual Result: Punch accepted and recorded as Present (Office)
Impact: Breaches compliance and allows remote attendance fraud

Title: Inverted Date Selection Allowed in Leave Request Form (End Date < Start Date)
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open Apply Leave 2. Select From Date 28-Sep 3. Select To Date 20-Sep 4. Submit
Expected Result: To Date picker disables dates before From Date; form blocks submission
Actual Result: Form accepts inverted dates and sends negative days payload causing 500 error
Impact: Causes unhandled server exceptions and corrupted leave logs

Title: Security Flaw: Unencrypted JWT Auth Token & PII Cached in Plaintext Redux Store
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Login to app 2. Inspect AsyncStorage database in app sandbox
Expected Result: Auth tokens and PII encrypted in Android Keystore / EncryptedSharedPreferences
Actual Result: Tokens, bank details, and PAN stored in plaintext JSON
Impact: PII and session hijacking risk on shared/rooted devices

Title: Indeterminate Spinner & Crash on Network Loss during Attendance Punch
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Tap Clock In 2. Immediately enable Airplane Mode 3. Observe app state
Expected Result: App displays network timeout error banner with Retry CTA within 10s
Actual Result: Infinite spinner freezes screen; unhandled promise rejection error occurs
Impact: User cannot verify punch status; app force-quit required

Title: Duplicate Leave Requests Created on Rapid Double-Tap due to Missing Idempotency
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Fill leave form 2. Rapidly double-tap Submit button within 300ms 3. Check Leave log
Expected Result: Button disables immediately on first tap; single leave request created
Actual Result: Duplicate identical leave requests created, deducting double leave balance
Impact: Deducts extra leave balance and clutters manager approvals
